corrections: INTRINSIC-VALUE ANCHOR OVERSTATED (load-bearing): management's Economic Value per share is EUR 47.59 at 31-Dec-2025 (FY25 release), NOT the ~EUR 54-55 carried in the debate. The 13.7% was EV growth 'at constant economics'; the published per-share mark has DECLINED in absolute EUR for two straight years (EUR 51 end-2023 -> EUR 48 end-2024 -> EUR 47.59 end-2025). Any fair value reconciled against a EUR 54-55 mark is ~15% inflated; a corrected mid-cycle fair value is nearer EUR 35-38 than EUR 40.

PEAK-CYCLE EARNINGS ANCHOR (downside understated): the EUR 4.76 FY25 EPS (verified) is a peak-underwriting-year print (FY25 combined ratio 82.3%, benign cat). Softening is verified and DEEPENING through 2026: Guy Carpenter global/US property-cat rate-on-line -12% at 1/1/26 and ~-16% by the July 2026 renewals (APAC -19%), the biggest annual decline since 2014; SCOR's own Feb-2026 renewals release guides its net underwriting ratio +2.0pts. At EUR 31.60 the stock trades at ~6.6x peak EPS, essentially AT the bear floor (4.76 x 6.5 = EUR 30.9); on a normalized soft-cycle EPS of ~3.8-4.2 the same 6.5x floor is EUR 25-27, so downside-to-break is ~15-20%, not the 6-12% stated in risk_reward. Offset (verified): Q1 2026 still over-earned - net income EUR 225M, combined ratio 80.2%, solvency +5pts to ~220%, EUR 300M added to P&C buffers.

REVENUE FIGURE OFF (direction holds): FY2025 insurance revenue was EUR 15,378M, -4.6% YoY per the primary release, not EUR 14.8B / -5.4% as the bear cites. The top line IS shrinking; the load-bearing number needed fixing.

GOVERNANCE TAIL UNDERSTATED: SCOR SE itself has been under judicial examination (mise en examen) as a LEGAL ENTITY since April 2025 over the alleged Kessler-era scheme to derail Covea's PartnerRe acquisition - not merely a background matter tied to a deceased individual. Unquantified tail, same adversary as the arbitration. Not a kill: the June 25, 2026 award itself is contained (USD 488.3M gross, ~EUR 50M net Q2-26 after provisions, no solvency/liquidity impact, shares steady ~EUR 31-32). Note the upheld treaties CONTINUE to be performed - 30% of the Irish L&H book (as at 31-Dec-2020) cedes to Covea alongside the cash award. A prior claim that the tribunal found SCOR breached disclosure obligations could NOT be verified against SCOR's release or reachable coverage and is dropped.

CFO TIMING: Francois de Varenne ceased as Group CFO on March 7, 2026 (not end-2025), moving to Senior Advisor after closing the FY25 accounts; successor Philipp Rueede had ~9 months inside SCOR (joined June 2025 as L&H CEO). Orderly, but the turnaround's financial architect is out of the seat.

RATING OPTIONALITY LIVE BUT UNEXERCISED: Fitch revised SCOR's outlook to Positive on Oct 14, 2025 (A+ affirmed); Moody's A1, AM Best A (still below the pre-2023 A+), no upgrade landed as of July 2026. catalyst_status=FIRED verifies exactly: the one hard catalyst (Covea) resolved June 25, 2026 with zero re-rate.
